scope: Six complete written-source bodies; linked documents and images remain separate

resources.title: SEND sunset and Send Arcade independence
resources.author: Yash (@yashhsm)
resources.summary: Yash announces the SEND sunset, with Send Arcade continuing as an independent game studio. A January 31, 2026 burn deadline concerned eligibility for possible future allocations, not guaranteed redemption. Foundation treasury wind-down and future financing were plans; completion is not established.
resources.boundary: Complete visible post text read in the normal browser. Author is not automatically attributed as Send Arcade founder. Embedded image not separately reviewed.

resources.title: NFA.space: historical NFT-holder revenue sharing
resources.author: gm0218 / NFA.space
resources.summary: Historical NFT-holder programme describes a 10% share of sales after marketplace fees when physical-painting NFTs are reused in new digital series, with wider rewards proposed. These terms concern specified NFT collections and must not be transferred to the later NFA ownership coin.
resources.boundary: Complete available written body read. Updated October 22, 2024. Linked Public Offer Agreement and actual distributions not reviewed or verified.

resources.title: NFA.space: second-year retrospective
resources.author: BogdanNFA
resources.summary: Historical retrospective describes a May 2022 start, digital and phygital collections, and self-reported artist and collector reach. The 2024 figures are not current traction or independently audited results.
resources.boundary: Complete written body read in normal browser; updated May 13, 2024. Embedded roadmap images and charts not separately reviewed.

resources.title: NFA.space: Futardio ICO plan
resources.author: BogdanNFA
resources.summary: Primary announcement links the exact subsequently unsuccessful $125K raise and proposes an eight-month budget at $15,625 monthly. Claimed revenue and artwork sales are issuer figures; audit, marketplace, governance and vault milestones are prospective. The article does not establish completion of its roadmap.
